emblemDescription: Goldener Angelhaken mit Welle auf Schieferblau.

prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the face opening of this newly generated knight. The current helmet has accidentally become empty and faceless. Keep the low segmented iron helmet and cheek guards, but move cheek guards outwards enough that the eyes and nose are unobstructed; no face plate over the eyes. Preserve the entire body, pose, hook pole weapon, blue brigandine, gold hook crest, clothing, proportions, paint texture and all transparent areas exactly. Full body 2:3, genuine transparent PNG, no background or cast shadow. The second reference is only the approved style.
reason: Face opening corrected; unselected first output archived.
